result:
The Green–Lazarsfeld index of $C_q$ is $\left\lfloor \frac{d-3}{2} \right\rfloor$, equivalently $\left\lfloor \frac{d-1}{2} \right\rfloor - 1$. I did not derive this from first principles. It matches my recollection of results of Euisung Park on syzygies of projected elliptic normal curves, so treat it as a recalled result rather than a verified one.

As a sanity check, $C_q \subset \mathbb{P}^{d-2}$ is a genus-1 curve of degree $d$, and the formula gives index $0$ at $d=5$, $1$ at $d=6$, and $2$ at $d=7$.

ANSWER: $\left\lfloor \frac{d-3}{2} \right\rfloor$
